label: The nature of a being whose esse is its essence is not received in matter
paraphrase: For every x whose represented esse equals its represented essence, x's nature is not received in matter (not InMatter x). Reading of De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch; Leonine c.4): 'et multo minus reciperet additionem materiae, quia iam esset esse non subsistens sed materiale'. Sense gap (2026-11-27): the source sentence ('si autem ponatur aliqua res, quae sit esse tantum') is about esse tantum (OWN_BEING_1); this Lean reading states it of beings whose represented esse equals their represented essence (OWN_BEING_2). On OWN_BEING_2 a real-identity account of creatures can deny it; see DISAMB 1bff3cb4 and docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md.
